system.notes:
A Williams Technologies netgun modified by BacteriTech to catch ASTRAL targets: its net of hollow polymer tubes is filled with FAB-1 fat bacteria. For human-sized or smaller targets. The first trigger primes a net (forcing FAB-1 in from the holding vat); a primed net stays active 6–8 hours; each net fires once. Needs a self-contained feeding canister (1,000¥ per 4 standard nets, 1,500¥ per 4 large). Ranges are not printed: the light-pistol bands of the base Williams netgun are used. May be drone-mounted; top- and underbarrel accessories only. Legality is not printed in the catalog. Corporate Security Handbook p.70.

Resolving a hit (p.103). With sr2e 0.105 or later, a hit posts a net card instead of damage. The target clicks Resist the net: Astral Reaction (+ Astral Pool) against TN 5 (standard net) or 8 (large net), 3 when a standard net hits a large target, and needs more than twice the attacker's successes. A net that holds pins the astral form (not the body): it can't move, and the player can't end the projection under it. Escape from the token HUD or the card, once per Combat Turn, the TN falling by 1 for every turn entangled; when twice the attacker's successes is more than every die the victim can roll, the dialog says no escape is possible.
